warband.name: Norse Explorers
warband.rules:
Choice: Exactly 1 Jarl. Max. 2 Berserkers, 1 Wulfen, 2 Bondsmen; any number of Marauders, max. 5 Hunters, max. 5 Wolves (only with a Wulfen).
Seafaring: All Norse warriors get +2 Strength when trying to row a boat.

units.name: Jarl
units.sp: Leader: Friendly models within 6" may use his Leadership for Ld tests.

units.name: Wulfen
units.sp: Fear, Bestial (immune to psychology), can never become the leader. No weapons/armour.

units.name: Wolf
units.sp: Animal (gains no experience). Only usable with a Wulfen (Pack Leader).

intro.text: Norsca lies far to the north, and its raiders and sea-wolves are among the fiercest fighters of the Old World. Mordheim's wyrdstone and plunder call them south, with wolf-warriors among them.

unitLore.jarl: The Jarl of a Norse warband is the most battle hardened veteran of his group and often a lesser clan chieftain of his tribe. He has seen many battles and is used to the bloodshed. While some Jarls choose to command their forces with strategy, most just run into the fray with the rest of the warriors. However the Jarl decides to run his warband, all of the other warriors respect him and look up to him.
unitLore.berserker: Berserkers are some of the most ferocious warriors in any Norse warband. They have proven their worth over countless battles and have learned that death is nothing to be feared. They charge into battle without any regard for their own safety and are really quite demented.
unitLore.wulfen: Wulfen are Berserkers with a very rare mutation. When there is a full moon, or when blood starts flowing on the battlefield, the mysterious and deadly Wulfen turn into blood hungry beasts, part man, and part wolf or bear. These creatures are known and greatly feared as werewolves to most Old Worlders. To the Norse they are Werekin, monstrous beasts which can tear through flesh and armour with their huge claws and massive fangs as they go on the rampage.
unitLore.bondsmen: These are young fighters who are still inexperienced. They are bonded to their Jarl by the oath of servitude.
unitLore.marauder: Marauders are the standard warriors in any Norse warband. They have experienced bloodshed and have been trained to fight since they were children. Marauders are so named as they are pirates and raiders.
unitLore.nhunter: Hunters are expertly skilled in stalking the wild game of the Umbra. When warriors are exiled from a tribe they become renegades, following Norse champions on epic voyages to offer ranged attacks as well as their exceptional hunting skills.
unitLore.wolf: The harsh lands of Norsca are inhabited by a great many ferocious beasts: massive woolly mammoths, vicious polar bears and wolves far larger than those encountered elsewhere in the world. Norse hunters capture and use these beasts. Properly trained they make formidable foes.
